featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Firstly “Believe in miracles” — because after so many years of consistent increase in your glass number and  reliable care from our side, it’s quite remarkable that a routine change in prescription (in fact, a reduction in your glasses number) is being treated as a mistake rather than a positive outcome.

Infact we have done the impossible ( reduced your glass number )

Vision correction can sometimes take a short adaptation period, especially when there is a change in power. It does not necessarily mean the check-up was “not done properly

For example, when a patient’s number reduces from, say, -2.00 to -1.50, the vision initially feels “different” or even unclear with new glasses. This is not because the prescription is wrong, but because the eyes and brain are still adjusting to improved vision and reduced dependence on power. Most patients adapt within a few days.

Not every change is an error — sometimes, it’s actually an improvement. But perhaps that’s the miracle that went unnoticed here.

Also, it’s disappointing that 8 years of accurate check-ups and good service were not even taken into account before posting such a strong public review.

It’s surprising how quickly years of trust and good results have been overlooked

Nonetheless, we hope we have been able to explain our side clearly enough to help you understand the situation better.

We doctors are now getting used to this type of behavior from our patients.

However that does not change our committment, we will continue to do what is best for our patents

featured_reviews.name: Sunita Salunke
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm absolutely thrilled with the outcome of my cataract surgery with Dr. Sachin Gaidhankar! 😊 The entire process was seamless, and the results are life-changing. He took the time to explain every step, making me feel at ease throughout the process. The staff was also super supportive. If you're considering cataract surgery, I highly recommend Dr. Sachin Gaidhankar - he's the best! 👍 5 stars isn't enough but that is the maximum it is allowing me to give 😂.
